secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com). Enables the Anthropic provider for chat, Enhance Prompt, planning and file generation.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com). Enables the OpenAI provider.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai/keys). Enables the OpenRouter provider.

secrets.name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint (optional).

secrets.name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://my-endpoint/v1 (optional).

secrets.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of a reachable Ollama instance, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:11434 (optional; no key required).
